Package com.nrg948.actuator

Class NullMotorAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.nrg948.actuator.NullMotorAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
MotorController, MotorController
public class NullMotorAdapter extends Object implements MotorController
A motor controller adapter that does nothing. This is useful for testing and for mechanisms that may not have a motor controller (e.g. a passive joint).
